snippet.title: ROSJA - WIĘZIENIE NARODÓW | Telegrafista 1920: Pieśni Wojny
snippet.description:
PLAY DEMO ON STEAM: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2613430

A rhythm historical game about sending Morse code to the beat in 1920 (Polish-Soviet War).

Join our Discord server: https://discord.com/invite/VmqQyX5Ng7

More info: https://telegraphist1920.com

Voice: Andrzej Ferenc
